text: XXIX. 1. Pañc'ime bhikkhave caṅkame ānisaṃsā. Katame pañca? [page 030] 30 Aṅguttara-Nikāya. XXIX. 2-XXX. 1 2. Addhānakkhamo hoti, padhānakkhamo hoti, appābādho hoti, asitapītakhāyitasāyitasammāpariṇāmaṃ gacchati, caṅkamādhigato samādhi ciraṭṭhitiko hoti. Ime kho bhikkhave pañca caṅkame ānisaṃsā ti.
